name: Iwamoto Akiko
source:
A tidy and motherly, family-oriented wife that’s quite tolerant and has a strong sense of cleanliness. 

She looks so young that you wouldn’t know she had two kids. She is usually satisfied with her current lifestyle, being surrounded by her kind husband and energetic children. 

But recently, she has been recalling the throbbing feeling of when she originally fell in love and now longs for those feelings once more. 

A woman’s heart never forgets.
